universe_reason: Seven established large stocks from the existing frozen quote research cohort, selected before new outcome inspection. Conditional survivor sample, not historical point-in-time selection.
target: Next available session open-to-close simple return in basis points
features_available: Prior session completed daily bar; no target-day feature is used
weights: Equal weights or normalized inverse calibration MSE, frozen after 2024. No validation tuning.
fees: Existing frozen 2026-09-30 NSE intraday model applied counterfactually to all evaluation dates
limitations: Daily open/close are idealized reference prices, not verified achievable fills or broker square-off prices
No intraday stop, margin, shortability, queue, depth or actual spread evidence
Corporate-action adjustment and historical universe membership are unverified
Single static chronological split; no claim of independent or untouched final holdout
